gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hierog: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs has outward-pointing terminals and a tall x-height that nearly meets the capitals. Megrim sits above it, angular and futuristic, and the two feel like a sleek sign over a friendly counter.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Megrim draws its angular, futuristic letters with a thickness like neon glass tubing, every stroke ending at one measured width. Noto Sans Arabic follows with wide openings and a tall lowercase.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Futuristic and angular, Megrim traces each letter like a laser-etched line. Noto Sans Armenian underneath is approachable, with standing-tall c, s and z and wide round openings, and it would take a modest body size comfortably.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Avestan keeps its curve tips from touching and lifts its lowercase high. Megrim handles the angular, one-tip-drawn drama of a heading, while the body font simply makes the text easy to follow.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Noto Sans Balinese reads modern and professional, with short ascenders. A long run of it would feel spacious and unhurried, each curve holding breathing room, while Megrim keeps its pen pressure steady above.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-bamum: A pen that never changes pressure or angle is the whole story of Megrim, angular and futuristic. Noto Sans Bamum answers with curved strokes ending before they turn inward and big open counters, making the pair crisp and modern.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads contemporary, its big midsection filling the line and its c open-jawed like pliers. Megrim above is cut like laser sheet at one stroke width, so the heading looks sharp and the text looks sturdy.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-batak: Megrim looks drawn with a ruler and compass, angular and futuristic with a skyward x-height line. Noto Sans Batak takes over with a towering x-height and a wide-open e, and that approachable sturdiness is the pair's best quality.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Megrim's lines keep their width through every turn, giving the heading an angular, futuristic precision on top of Noto Sans Bengali. That body font's open letter mouths make the pair feel contemporary.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki is approachable, its lowercase swollen like tight-coiled rope. Over many lines it would stay easy to follow, with open apertures, while Megrim's steel-cable outline of a heading adds an angular, futuristic edge.
